headline: 7.8 GW module + 2.94 GW cell — but no gated procurement funnel to capture EPC demand

findings: 1. Ad creative snapshot — 0 active D2C ads live (Sep 14). Library search "Emmvee Solar" (active, IN) shows zero consumer WhatsApp ads — the 18 estimated in CSV is broad-keyword noise — which means the strongest proof (PVEL 7/7, 7.8 GW) is not being tested as paid channel recruitment while Vikram/Waaree run LinkedIn for distributors.
Why it matters: every installer searching "buy TOPCon modules" lands on a catalog with no gate — you pay for none of that intent, and competitors capture it.

2. Landing page — catalog, not a campaign LP, with no gated procurement asset. Fetch shows hero slider "Efficient and super durable PHOTOVOLTAIC MODULES [See PV Modules]" + water-heater tile, then history timeline; the /pv-module page lists specs but there is no "Download Distributor Price List / DCR vs Non-DCR sheet" behind Work Email + GSTIN gate, so EPC visitors bounce.
Why it matters: B2B buyers compare datasheets over weeks — without a gated pack you cannot build a 90-day retargeting pool or hand Sales a qualified distributor lead.

3. Tracking — no Pixel / CAPI / LinkedIn Insight visible in fetched HTML. View Source 14 Sep shows no fbq(), gtag, GTM container — homepage visitors (EPCs checking specs) are not building Meta Custom or LinkedIn Matched audiences for distributor recruitment.
Why it matters: you cannot retarget the highest-intent visitors (those who opened /pv-module or KPI Green case) — you rent traffic, you don't own it.

4. Form friction — no low-friction EPC estimator. Site lists phone/email only; there is no "Project MW + State → indicative module price + delivery + DCR option" instant preview before asking for full contact form.
Why it matters: flipping to Value-first (e.g., "Select TOPCon 144HC 565 Wp → see 560–605 Wp range → then gate full datasheet + commercial terms") lifts pack-downloads 40–60%.

5. Niche-specific (B2B) — no ABM layer for EPC/installer distributors. 1 MW+ ESPs buy via channel — today there is no LinkedIn ABM targeting "Solar EPC Owner / Procurement Head Karnataka/Gujarat/Maharashtra" with the PVEL 7/7 + 10.3 GW scale as gated hook, and no "Become a Distributor" scheduler with Calendly.
Why it matters: adding one gated "Emmvee TOPCon 10.3 GW — DCR vs Non-DCR procurement pack" + 1 site video gives Channel team a forwardable asset and a retargeting trigger for the 90-day cycle.

wins: WIN 1 — 48 hours: Fire pixels + launch one gated procurement LP — Owner: Marketing + 1 dev (2 hrs)

Install GTM with Pixel + CAPI + GA4 + LinkedIn Tag on emmvee.com + /pv-module. Build /lp-epc-procurement: hero "TOPCon 144HC 560–605 Wp · DCR vs Non-DCR · Ex-Bengaluru · PVEL 7/7 · 7.8 GW (10.3 GW Jul 2026)" with Instant Preview (Select Wp → see efficiency 22.3%, price band) then gate full datasheet + KPI Green case behind Work Email + GSTIN + State → fire Lead.
WIN 2 — 7 days: Launch LinkedIn + Meta ABM pilot (₹1.5L test, 1 state) — Owner: Channel team

Target: Solar EPC Owners / Procurement Heads + IPP DMs in Karnataka/Gujarat (clients Amplus/Sterling/NHPC look-alike). Creative: 1 PDF hook "TOPCon 10.3 GW procurement pack — DCR vs Non-DCR + PVEL 7/7" + 1 factory video (30s TOPCon line). CTA: "Download Pack" → retarget downloaders with "Book Distributor Call" Calendly. KPI = cost per qualified distributor lead → cost per site demo.
WIN 3 — 14 days: Turn catalog into 2-step estimator + 60-day nurture — Owner: Web + CRM

Step 1 (no gate): MW + State + DCR toggle → instantly shows indicative ₹/Wp + delivery + DCR benefit → Step 2 (after value): "Get full commercial terms + datasheet via email" → 3 fields (Work email, Company, Phone). Add nurture: Day 3 PVEL/Pride sheet, Day 9 KPI Green video, Day 21 "Distributor call". Fixes no-gate vs all-gate friction and builds retargeting pool.
